basic_info.description: Welcome to this updated classic in San Francisco's vibrant Excelsior Neighborhood. Endless Potential: You will absolutely love the amount of natural light that floods into this home. Discover the possibilities in this recently remodeled 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home which includes a separate unit with its own private entrance, It actually feels like a 2 unit duplex as the lower unit has its own entrance,  Upper Level: Features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, a formal dining room, and a spacious living room that is showcased by a beautiful fireplace with original built in wood cabinetry and original hardwood floors that have recently been re-finished. Lower Level: A versatile 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit and kitchen area  with a separate entrance, ideal for in-laws  extended family, guests, or rental income.  Conveniently located with easy access to Highways 280 and 101, this home sits on a generous lot with a large backyard and an original built in brick bbq and a lemon tree plus potential for a private deck or future expansion.
